pageProps.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish (2022)
pageProps.review: A review of Puss in Boots: The Last Wish, a film that goes beyond simple animation to leave a deep lingering impression with its harmony of charming characters and unexpected emotions.
pageProps.content:
## Review Watching the cheerful puppy character brought unexpected tears. It's a movie that unexpectedly gives you a lot to think about, even if you go in without much thought.
Every single character that appears is charming.
